{{Top|leg}}
A '''wave-weapon''' was a device capable of turning their victims into smoking ash. They were created around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] to fight the creatures of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] during the [[Beast Wars]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
